analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md (head lines 2966-2970), a documentation paragraph about the cluster update flow. The edit adds that the control leader's ClusterService.checkForUpdate re-plans only once both Macs answer with the same worker build (ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild), and links to a coordinated-update doc. No code, config, key handling, attestation, cache storage or protocol behavior changes. The supplied base units (lines 838-1644) are surrounding unchanged text covering Nemotron Super durable prefix-cache checkpoints, GLM5Next, calibration and engine flow. They were reviewed for context. The durable encrypted checkpoint description (SSDHybridCheckpointStore, cache scope partitioning, TTL-bounded store) is consistent with the retained T-041 posture (HMAC-keyed names, account-scoped salt, 30-minute TTL, SEC-035 accepted risk). The patch does not alter it. The changed lines (~2966) are outside the supplied units' line ranges, so I judged them from the patch excerpt alone. They reduce a plan-failure/availability window in the cluster re-plan path. This is a doc-only claim; the implementation of oneBuild and the linked cluster-always-on.md page were not supplied, so I could not verify that the doc matches the code. That is an unverified contract, not a finding. No threat-model assets, boundaries or mitigations are invalidated, and no new attack surface is introduced. No threat-model update is needed.
